fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.

mustFire.why: a full-bleed band with break-inside: avoid (negative horizontal margins, as wide as the sheet) that is 2.57 content boxes tall
mustFire.construction: margin-left and margin-right -0.75 in on a Letter page with 0.75 in margins: the band is 816 px wide and starts 72 px left of the content box. 40 px title + 64 rows x 36 px (fixed height, nowrap) = 2344 px against 912 px: pushed to a fresh page and split 904 + 900 + 540 px. Every fragment starts left of the content box by design.
mustFire.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-unbreakable-block-too-tall.md; nothing in the rule documentation exempts a block because it bleeds into the page margin.

dependsOn.status: rule change and documentation pending in this release
dependsOn.semantics: fragments belong to the flow by ancestry (inside the page content area, not a margin-box copy), not by where their box starts
dependsOn.basis: Read literally, docs/limitations.md at the base commit says the rule 'only counts a box that STARTS inside the content box of its page'; every fragment of this band starts 72 px left of it. The release removes that coordinate filter and its sentence (WP-F1). This entry holds under the flow-by-ancestry semantics documented in the same release.

mustNotFire.why: running element in the side margin boxes with break-inside: avoid. Each copy (320 px) fits its margin box and the content box (912 px); only a tool that sums the per-page margin-box copies as if they were fragments of one flow block would report it
mustNotFire.construction: div.sidetab: fixed height 320 px (box-sizing: border-box, overflow: hidden), break-inside: avoid, position: running(sidetab), placed in @left-middle on left pages and @right-middle on right pages. Five pages -> five copies: 5 x 320 = 1600 px, and the three right-page copies alone 960 px, both above 912 px. The right-page copies start exactly at the right edge of the content box.
